title: Out-of-roster class drop is double-counted: increments its reason bucket AND drop_other, inflating the panel total and ratio
detail: A drop with class >= 64 increments its reason bucket AND drop_other, so e9+pool+other exceeds the actual Packet_Dropped count — violating the acceptance phrase 'drop counters summing exactly the Packet_Dropped events' and skewing the ratio.
recommended_fix: Count out-of-roster classes in a separate overflow counter (or only in the log), keeping drop_other strictly for unknown reason bytes so the buckets stay disjoint.

title: noc_panel_rows undercounts the drawn rows by 3 unconditionally, so the scroll clamp can never reach the panel's bottom rows
evidence:
+// noc_panel_rows — the total row count (the scroll clamp's measure pass).
+// MUST agree with draw_noc_panel row-for-row (same count predicates).
+noc_panel_rows :: proc(stats: ^pp.Stats_Record, events: []pp.Event, sel_pipe: i64, log_n: u32) -> i32 {
+	rows := i32(2) // header: title + global line
+	rows += 2      // drops
+	rows += 2      // crisis root causes
+	rows += 1      // rejections
+
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "DEBUG OVERLAY (D)", NOC_INK)
+	glob := fmt.tprintf("tick %d  gen %d  score %d  meter %d%%", stats.tick, stats.gen, stats.score, stats.meter)
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, glob, NOC_INK_DIM)
+	hash := fmt.tprintf("hash %016x", stats.sim_hash)
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, hash, NOC_INK_SOFT)
+
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "DROPS since start (E9 lane-shed / E22 pool)", NOC_INK)
+	drops_line := fmt.tprintf("E9 %d  E22 %d  other %d  total %d", feed.drop_e9, feed.drop_pool, feed.drop_other, total_drops)
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, drops_line, NOC_AMBER)
+	ratio_line := fmt.tprintf("drop ratio %d%%  (%d / %d completed)  /3s %d", ratio, total_drops, delivered + total_drops, noc_feed_rate_total(feed))
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, ratio_line, NOC_INK_DIM)
+
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "CRISIS root causes", NOC_INK)
+	if feed.crisis_sat > 0 {
+		line := fmt.tprintf("Saturated_Bundle %d  (last b%d p%d cls %d)", feed.crisis_sat, feed.crisis_last_bundle, feed.crisis_last_pipe, feed.crisis_last_class)
+		cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, line, NOC_RED)
+	} else {
+		cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, "Saturated_Bundle 0", NOC_INK_DIM)
+	}
+	pool_line := fmt.tprintf("Pool_Exhaustion %d  other %d", feed.crisis_pool, feed.crisis_other)
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, pool_line, NOC_INK_DIM)
+	rej := fmt.tprintf("REJECTED, not dropped: %d (%s)", feed.reject_total, noc_reject_kind_label(feed))
+	cur = noc_row(v, cur, scroll, visible, rej, NOC_INK_SOFT)
+
+	scroll := clamp(scroll_in, 0, max(0, total - visible))
detail: Measure says 2+2+2+1 but draw emits 3 header rows, 3 drop rows, 4 crisis+rejection rows — always 3 more. With content over the 50-row viewport, max scroll (total-visible) leaves the bottom rows, the drop log, unreachable.
recommended_fix: Correct noc_panel_rows: header 3, drops 3, crisis header+2 lines+rejection; count every emitted row exactly as draw does (see also the conditional mismatches).

title: run-dev.sh advertises a --stats-out pass-through that is broken: ARGS is never forwarded to the app and the build line expands to an empty-string argument
evidence:
+# tools/run-dev.sh --stats-out

# pass-through (the app's telemetry flag) + odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:bin/app-dev "${ARGS[@]+}" 2>&1 | head -20 + +if [ "$E2E" = "1" ]; then + echo "run-dev: e2e drive — real windowed run, scripted D presses, ON/OFF captures (bin/noc-e2e-*.png)" + PP_NOC_E2E=1 ./bin/app-dev + echo "run-dev: e2e done — bin/noc-e2e-on.png (panel) vs bin/noc-e2e-off.png (no panel)" +else + ./bin/app-dev +fi
detail: ARGS is collected but only referenced via "${ARGS[@]+}", which expands to one empty-string argument — never the flags — and both run lines invoke the binary with no args. The documented pass-through silently does nothing.
recommended_fix: Drop ARGS from the odin line and exec "./bin/app-dev" "${ARGS[@]}" (or ${ARGS[@]+"${ARGS[@]}"} under set -u) so the flags reach the app.

title: Rejection latch only runs while the overlay is on — rejections made with the panel hidden collapse to one count
detail: The whole latch is nested under overlay_on: N rejections while hidden count as 1 at next reveal (only last_reject/reject_tick persist), and multiple rejections in one frame count once. Drop counters catch up fully; rejections cannot.
recommended_fix: Track last_reject/reject_tick transitions every frame regardless of overlay_on, or keep a small app-side rejection ring the feed scans like events.

title: Further noc_panel_rows/draw drift: sel_pipe counted +4 unconditionally, both empty-state placeholder rows uncounted, class filter ignored
detail: Beyond the constant +3 error: a dead/unstatable sel_pipe draws 0-1 rows not 4; each placeholder adds an unmeasured row; measure counts len(stats.classes) while draw skips out-of-roster classes. More drift past 'MUST agree'.
recommended_fix: Mirror draw's predicates: +4 only when pipe_slot succeeds and a stats row matches; +1 per placeholder; count only in-roster class rows.

evidence:

detail: The comment names the F key, but the poll, the e2e injection, the panel title ('DEBUG OVERLAY (D)') and the README all use D — a stale leftover from the dropped F plan misdocumenting the toggle.

title: Spec artifact contradicts itself on the toggle key: Tasks/Verification say F, the ruling and the code say D
evidence:
+ e2e auto-drive (PP_NOC_E2E=1: inject Key_Press{.F} after the polls at frame N, TakeScreenshot on/off, exit)
+
+- `odin build app -define:PP_DEBUG=true -out:app-debug.bin` -- expected: compiles; F toggles the panel
+
+- 2026-08-22 (user ruling via Gru, final): the D KEY stays as the toggle — it is the established 5.7 debug-key slot
+
+				append(&ictx.events, inp.Device_Event(inp.Key_Press{key = .D}))
detail: The shipped spec's task list still says inject Key_Press{.F} and its verification says 'F toggles the panel', contradicting the same file's final D ruling and the implementation, which injects .D.
recommended_fix: Amend the two stale F references in the spec artifact to D so the frozen doc matches the ruling and the code.

title: '/3s' rate freezes after quiet periods — the rate rings only roll when a drop event arrives
detail: ring_tick advances only inside drop folding. After 60+ dropless ticks the true last-60-tick rate is 0, but the labeled '/3s' readout keeps showing the frozen window of the last drop.
recommended_fix: Roll the rings each frame with the current sim tick (a noc_feed_roll entry point), or blank/age the rate display when tick minus ring_tick exceeds the window.

title: Panel chrome hand-rolled with DrawRectangle/DrawRectangleLines instead of the spec-mandated shared draw_panel_card
evidence:
+- SHARE, never fork: reuse `draw_text_c` / `draw_panel_card`; the NOC feed is the one shared accumulator/ring
+
+	rl.DrawRectangle(NOC_PANEL_X - 8, NOC_PANEL_Y - 10, NOC_PANEL_W + 16, NOC_PANEL_H + 20, rl.Color{255, 252, 244, 230})
+	rl.DrawRectangleLines(NOC_PANEL_X - 8, NOC_PANEL_Y - 10, NOC_PANEL_W + 16, NOC_PANEL_H + 20, rl.Color{51, 65, 79, 60})
detail: The Always-constraint says reuse draw_panel_card; the merged panel forks its own background/border pair instead — exactly the shared-chrome fork the constraint forbids.
recommended_fix: Render the panel background via draw_panel_card (forecast.odin:117) and delete the manual rectangle pair.

title: Stale out-of-range bundle renders 'map-wide' — the E22 designation — instead of the promised 'gone'
detail: A shrunk bundle array sends stale E9 rows down the NO_BUNDLE branch, printing 'map-wide' (the pool-drop label) rather than 'gone' — mislabeling stale pipe drops as map-wide.
recommended_fix: Split the conditions: NO_BUNDLE renders 'map-wide'; index >= len(bundle_lo) renders 'gone'.

title: Noc_Feed.crisis_last_cause is written but never read
evidence:
+	crisis_last_cause: u8,
+
+		f.crisis_last_cause = e.cause
+
+		line := fmt.tprintf("Saturated_Bundle %d  (last b%d p%d cls %d)", feed.crisis_sat, feed.crisis_last_bundle, feed.crisis_last_pipe, feed.crisis_last_class)
detail: crisis_last_cause is set in noc_feed_fold_crisis but no reader exists — the new file holds every possible reader, the readout prints bundle/pipe/class only, and no test reads it.
recommended_fix: Print the cause in the Saturated_Bundle 'last' line, or delete the field.

title: Wheel scroll truncates fractional deltas to zero — trackpad scrolling does nothing
detail: GetMouseWheelMove returns fractional values (trackpads, high-resolution wheels); the w != 0 test passes but i32(w) truncates toward zero, so sub-1.0 deltas never move the scroll.
recommended_fix: Accumulate a f32 scroll remainder (or round away from zero) before applying the integer step.
